camel_example: aliyun cas ListDeploymentJob --region cn-hangzhou --Status pending --JobType user --CurrentPage 1 --ShowSize 50
description_en: Retrieves a list of deployment tasks after you create a deployment task
description_zh: 创建部署任务后，您可以通过该接口获取部署任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun cas list-deployment-job --job-type user --status pending --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeploymentJob

parameters.help_en: The number of certificates to display per page in a paged query. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页显示证书的数量。默认值为50
parameters.name: show_size

CurrentPage.description_en: The current page number. Default value: 1

Data.description_en: The data returned by the API

CertDomain.description_en: The domain names included in the certificate of the deployment task
CertDomain.description_zh: 部署任务证书包含的域名

CertType.description_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

upload: uploaded certificate
buy: purchased certificate
free: personal test certificate (supported only on the China site)
CertType.description_zh:
证书类型。

upload：上传证书
buy：自购证书
free：个人测试证书（仅中国站支持）

Del.description_en:
The deletion flag. This parameter has no practical significance. Valid values:

0: not deleted.
1: deleted
Del.description_zh:
删除标识，无实际意义。

0：未删除
1：已删除

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the deployment task execution, in UNIX timestamp format (seconds)
EndTime.description_zh: 部署任务执行结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the deployment task was created, in UNIX timestamp format (seconds)
GmtCreate.description_zh: 部署任务创建时间（秒，时间戳格式）

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the deployment task was last modified, in UNIX timestamp format (seconds)
GmtModified.description_zh: 部署任务上次修订时间（秒，时间戳格式）

Id.description_en: The deployment task ID. You can use this ID to query the deployment task details and status
Id.description_zh: 部署任务ID。后续可用于查询部署任务详情、部署任务状态等

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the deployment task

JobType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

cloud: multi-cloud deployment task.
user: cloud service deployment task (excluding ECS instances)
JobType.description_zh:
任务类型。

cloud：多云部署任务
user：云产品部署任务（不含云服务器）

Name.description_en: The name of the deployment task

ProductName.description_en: The cloud services included in the deployment task resources
ProductName.description_zh: 部署任务资源包含云产品

Rollback.description_en:
Indicates whether the task contains a rollback worker. For example, if a cloud service in the task has been rolled back, the value 1 is returned. Valid values:

0: does not contain a rollback worker.
1: contains a rollback worker
Rollback.description_zh:
是否包含回滚任务worker。例如某个任务中的某个云产品执行过回滚，则返回1。

0：不包含回滚任务worker
1：包含回滚任务worker

ScheduleTime.description_en: The scheduled time of the task, in UNIX timestamp format (seconds)
ScheduleTime.description_zh: 任务调度时间（时间戳格式，精确到秒）

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the deployment task execution, in UNIX timestamp format (seconds)
StartTime.description_zh: 部署任务执行开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）

Status.description_en:
The deployment task status. Valid values:

pending: pending execution.
editing: being edited.
scheduling: being scheduled.
processing: being deployed.
error: deployment failed.
success: deployment succeeded
Status.description_zh:
部署任务状态。

pending：待执行
editing：编辑中
scheduling：调度中
processing：部署中
error：部署失败
success：部署成功

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ShowSize.description_en: The number of deployment tasks per page. Default value: 50
ShowSize.description_zh: 每页包含部署任务的个数。默认值为50

Total.description_en: The total number of deployment tasks returned
Total.description_zh: 查询到的部署任务总数
